label: second fix-round (late relative to rounds 1-2, written before round 3)
expectation: The Codex re-review of 6155b51 showed the round-2 'S' marker is written before fsync, registration and the engine call, so an unmatched S does not prove an engine-level write was interrupted. Round 3 adds an 'I b t' marker written immediately before the engine call (insert/append) and kills only when the last marker is I, no ack exists for b, and at least 25% of the median insert duration of the acknowledged batches has elapsed since I. Proof of an interrupted engine write: I(b) < kill time, no A(b), and elapsed-in-engine at kill >= 0.25 x median (A-I) duration. Expected: all four stores pass per-batch verification with the in-flight batch absent or complete.
criteria: settled if round 3 shows engine-level interruption by that criterion for all four stores and per-batch verification passes; advanced (naming the store) otherwise.
note: Round 3 reruns the full bench for all four stores (third sample); rounds 1 and 2 stay retained.
